## Overview

This week we will learn how to work with **tabular data** in R,
and how to visualize data with the `ggplot2` package of the `tidyverse`.

## Lectures & Learning goals

Some of the things you will learn this week:

#### [Working with tabular data in R](./w13a_data-wrangling.qmd)

- Data frames and different functions to reorganize and modify data frames
- Briefly about the similar matrix data structure

#### [Data visualization with ggplot2](./w13b_data-viz.qmd)

- Basic syntax of `ggplot` function in R
- How to create different types of plots using `ggplot2` package in R 
- How to add different layers of information to the plots 
- Export the plots in different formats
